|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Plays on table. You lose no Force to opponent's Boonta Eve Podrace. Opponent's Force retrieval from Boonta Eve Podrace may not be canceled. Unless opponent occupies more battlegrounds than you, Watto's Box is suspended. When played from An Unusual Amount Of Fear, does not count against your thrice per game limit.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Traffic Control (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Plays on table. “Three” on An Unusual Amount Of Fear is treated as “Four.” You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. Opponent’s retrieval from Boonta Eve Podrace may not be canceled. While you occupy three battlegrounds, Watto’s Box is suspended.” '''What changed:''' added ““Three” on An Unusual Amount Of Fear is treated as “Four.””; removed “opponent's”; “Opponent's Force” → “Opponent’s”; “Unless opponent occupies more battlegrounds than you, Watto's” → “While you occupy three battlegrounds, Watto’s”; removed “When played from An Unusual Amount Of Fear, does not count against your thrice per game limit.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 21. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Traffic Control]].
* Later text: [[Traffic Control (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Traffic Control (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Traffic Control]].
